name: 91401 · Van Nuys, CA
findings: ZIP 91401 (Van Nuys) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91401 (Van Nuys) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91401 (Van Nuys) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
